Russian names Сияющий осколок and Штормовая пыль are Gleaming Shard and Storm Dust; this is the same original Wowhead Looter dataset as any English/PTR mirror, not a new independent cohort. The rendered index omits linked output item IDs and quality ranks. Visible output rows with the same translated name must remain distinct until the original HTML identifies their links. No all-zero disenchant operation count is established by the sum of source rows; do not infer missing results, fill rank/quantity probabilities, or apply as current live gold EV.
